rationale: ConfigurationTyped is precisely an existential current environment realizing configuration.state with an empty pending list together with SequenceTyped for configuration.code to the fixed finalEnvironment. Realizes supplies the required well-formed typed class table and the exact current variable domain. It uses Unpacking.Configuration, so the configuration judgment applies to the extended language. The selected Unpacking.Steps is the reflexive/step closure with the same order as given.executions; Unpacking.Stuck means not finished and no extended successor, and Configuration.finished is exactly empty code. The configuration definition and the simple initial/finished supporting statements do not assert static preservation or progress. I interpret the reference to a common final environment as the role of this judgment parameter; its preservation across execution remains a draft obligation as explicitly stated in given.typing.declarations and AGENTS.md. The required dependency units introduce class/field/variable names and expressions (given.classes, given.syntax), finite maps and sequences (given.programs), typed class tables (given.typing.declarations), signed paths and value types (given.typing.views), positive/negative observations (given.typing.observations), and normalized focus/emptying before these are used. The relevant complete authored units and exact Lean selections, including transitive dependencies, were compared; no unresolved notation needed for this comparison was found.
